description: This file declares functions and variables related to quoting and dequoting strings for shell safety, path quoting, and language-specific string quoting. It provides utility functions for quoting, dequoting, and handling string buffers, primarily for safe command-line argument construction.

methods.name: sq_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for shell safety, writing to a strbuf.

methods.name: sq_quote_argv
methods.description: Quotes an array of arguments for shell safety.

methods.name: sq_quotef
methods.description: Formats and quotes a string with printf-style arguments.

methods.name: sq_quote_buf_pretty
methods.description: Pretty version of sq_quote_buf, avoiding quotes if no exotic characters.

methods.name: sq_quote_argv_pretty
methods.description: Pretty version of sq_quote_argv.

methods.name: sq_append_quote_argv_pretty
methods.description: Appends pretty-quoted arguments to a strbuf.

methods.name: sq_dequote
methods.description: Dequotes a string produced by sq_quote.

methods.name: sq_dequote_step
methods.description: Dequotes a single item and updates the pointer to the next character.

methods.name: sq_dequote_to_argv
methods.description: Dequotes multiple arguments in a string into an argv array.

methods.name: sq_dequote_to_strvec
methods.description: Dequotes arguments into a strvec, duplicating strings.

methods.name: unquote_c_style
methods.description: Dequotes a C-style quoted string.

methods.name: quote_c_style
methods.description: Quotes a string in C style, with flags.

methods.name: quote_two_c_style
methods.description: Quotes two strings in C style.

methods.name: write_name_quoted
methods.description: Writes a quoted name to a FILE.

methods.name: write_name_quoted_relative
methods.description: Writes a relative quoted name to a FILE.

methods.name: quote_path
methods.description: Quotes a path relative to a prefix.

methods.name: perl_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for Perl.

methods.name: perl_quote_buf_with_len
methods.description: Quotes a string for Perl with specified length.

methods.name: python_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for Python.

methods.name: tcl_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for Tcl.

methods.name: basic_regex_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for regex.
